summary: This bill makes it unlawful to store an unsecured firearm, requires adult supervision for juveniles possessing handguns, establishes civil penalties and a private right of action for violations, and creates a grant program for gun safety education.

scores.thoughts: This bill primarily focuses on stricter gun rules by requiring adult supervision for juvenile handgun possession and mandating secure storage for firearms, with penalties for non-compliance and a private right of action for injuries. It also establishes a grant program for gun safety education.

The bill introduces civil money penalties for violations of secure gun storage requirements and prohibits individuals with recent penalties from acquiring firearms, which represents a stricter approach to enforcing gun safety laws.
